Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The urine findings indicate a urinary tract infection (UTI) with significant bacteriuria (>100,000 CFU/mL E. coli), pyuria (elevated leukocytes), positive nitrites, leukocyte esterase, and hematuria. The low specific gravity may suggest dilute urine. No ketones or casts were detected. Recommend clinical correlation and consideration of antibiotic therapy based on sensitivity testing.
